title: Home practical guide and safety card: growing cress in three soils
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Soils and aquatic plants (Flow and One Planet, Our World)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 29 (Home practical guide and safety card: growing cress in three soils (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 29: Plants and soil: planning a growing test. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which soil cress grows best in
equipment: Three soils: sandy, garden soil, clay
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Fill each pot with a different soil
Sprinkle the same number of seeds on each
Put the pots in the same place with the same light
Give each pot the same amount of water each day
Measure the height of the cress every two days for ten days

questions.q: Big question: which soil do you predict will grow seeds best?
questions.a: Usually loam: it holds water, drains and has humus.
